available_skills.progress: Track plans and goal state. Planning mode updates authoritative plan with settled outcome, sequence, acceptance, boundaries, and next action. Goal mode initializes goals/<slug>.md only in executing task.
available_skills.code-review: Review the relevant preparation changes once; fix clear issues and report validation.
available_skills.create-pr: Open a PR only when execution reaches its delivery checkpoint.
available_skills.address-pr-feedback: Handle PR feedback when requested by executing delivery lifecycle.
available_skills.merge-branch: Follow authorized delivery lifecycle after review.

tool_catalog.create_thread: Create a separate task only on explicit request. Must call list_projects first for project selection. Params: title,prompt, target={type:project,projectId,environment:{type:worktree,startingState?:{type:working-tree}|{type:branch,branchName:string}}|{type:local}}, optional model,thinking. Git default worktree; nonGit local. Without explicit model omit model; without overrides preserve defaults. Available gpt-6-astra and gpt-5.6-luna support medium/high/max (astra also ultra). Returns either threadId+hostId or clientThreadId during setup. clientThreadId cannot be used with tools requiring threadId.
tool_catalog.list_threads: Returns tasks with threadId,hostId,title,projectId,status. Only actual threadId may be used with read_thread or wait_threads.
tool_catalog.wait_threads: Params targets [{threadId,hostId?,afterCursor?}],timeoutMs. Returns startup status and cursor. Prefer bounded waits; never duplicate task creation to poll.
tool_catalog.read_thread: Params threadId,hostId optional. Returns child outputs and tool summaries.
tool_catalog.create_goal: Child task can set native goal via create_goal({objective:string,token_budget?:number}); only explicit user goal request permits this. Do not set token_budget absent explicit budget request.
tool_catalog.get_goal: Child task can read native active goal status.
